statement: Acceptance obligations: The host ledger implements the persistent-active scheduling foundation in [distant-world.md](distant-world.md). / It is gated by the existing `sim.active_regions` switch, enabled in compiled and packaged defaults for v0.3.0. / Budgets remain unlimited in shipped configuration. / No distant system consumes this schedule yet; / field pages, creature records, water shares, diagnostics and measured budget activation remain separate work. / Durable completed work and ground-object continuation, durable regional fields/weather/scent/energy, regional foliage/water continuation (issue #242), and strict distant policy and distant creatures are planned for v0.3.1. / Regional continuation performance/default enablement is planned for v0.4.0 as [issue #320](https://github.com/d-addison/luminumbra/issues/320). / These consumers are outside the shipping scheduler foundation. / The dedicated server autosaves every five minutes; / this does not implement those continuation consumers.
